title: Basket Case
lyrics:
[00:00.00]Do you have the time to listen to me whine?
[00:05.21]About nothing and everything all at once
[00:11.25]I am one of those melodramatic fools
[00:16.55]Neurotic to the bone, no doubt about it
[00:23.05]Sometimes I give myself the creeps
[00:28.70]Sometimes my mind plays tricks on me
[00:33.67]It all keeps adding up
[00:36.16]I think I'm cracking up
[00:38.88]Am I just paranoid or am I just stoned?
[00:47.46]I went to a shrink to analyze my dreams
[00:52.93]She says it's lack of sex that's bringing me down
[00:58.35]I went to a whore, he said my life's a bore
[01:03.82]So quit my whining 'cause it's bringing her down
[01:10.20]Sometimes I give myself the creeps
[01:15.70]Sometimes my mind plays tricks on me
[01:20.52]It all keeps adding up
[01:22.88]I think I'm cracking up
[01:25.59]Am I just paranoid? Huh, yeah, yeah, yeah
[01:33.84]Oh, oh
[01:39.64]Grasping to control
[01:44.10]So I better hold on
[02:07.48]Sometimes I give myself the creeps
[02:12.91]Sometimes my mind plays tricks on me
[02:17.66]It all keeps adding up
